summary: A proxy can reduce avoidable clarification and routing work, but it should expose transformations and abstain when intent or urgency is uncertain.

points.text: Retain the raw request alongside normalized fields so reviewers can detect omissions, changed priority or invented acceptance criteria.
Measure time-to-first-correct-owner, duplicate precision, clarification rounds, requester rework and missed-severity incidents rather than number of tickets processed.
A confidence threshold should route ambiguous, security-sensitive or high-impact requests to a person instead of forcing a classification.
